messages.content: Hey, can you give me a quick overview of how lkjai handles task routing?

<action>
<reasoning>The user wants a concise overview of lkjai task routing. This is a direct informational query with no tools needed.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>lkjai routes tasks through a lightweight dispatcher that inspects the intent signature, picks the least-loaded worker queue, and streams results back via SSE. It falls back to a retry queue on timeout, with jittered exponential backoff.</content>
